==Directors' poll== [[File:Tokyo Monogatari 1953.jpg|thumb|''[[Tokyo Story]]'' (1953)]] In the 2012 directors' poll, ''[[Tokyo Story]]'' ranked first,{{cite web |url=https://www.bfi.org.uk/sight-and-sound/polls/greatest-films-all-time/directors-100-best |title=Directors' Top 100 |year=2012 |work=Sight & Sound |publisher=British Film Institute}} also replacing ''Citizen Kane'', which held the top spot in both of the previous decennial directors' polls.{{cite web |title=Directors' Top Ten Poll 2002 |work=Sight & Sound |publisher=British Film Institute |url=http://www.bfi.org.uk/sightandsound/topten/poll/critics.html |access-date=May 10, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020816030310/http://www.bfi.org.uk/sightandsound/topten/poll/directors.html |archive-date=August 16, 2002 |url-status=dead }} Among the directors that participated were [[Quentin Tarantino]], [[Martin Scorsese]], [[Ken Loach]] and [[Francis Ford Coppola]].
  1. ''[[Tokyo Story]]'' (48 mentions)
  2. ''[[2001: A Space Odyssey (film)|2001: A Space Odyssey]]'' (42 mentions)
  3. ''[[Citizen Kane]]'' (42 mentions)
  4. ''[[8½]]'' (40 mentions)
  5. ''[[Taxi Driver]]'' (34 mentions)
  6. ''[[Apocalypse Now]]'' (33 mentions)
  7. ''[[The Godfather]]'' (31 mentions)
  8. ''[[Vertigo (film)|Vertigo]]'' (31 mentions)
  9. ''[[The Mirror (1975 film)|Mirror]]'' (30 mentions)
  10. ''[[Bicycle Thieves]]'' (29 mentions)
